name: ChatGPT Pulse
desc: A daily briefing ChatGPT researched overnight, sunset in June 2026.
desc_zh: ChatGPT 夜里查资料、清早推送的每日简报，2026 年 6 月已下线。
solves: A chat assistant only speaks when you open it, so what you never thought to ask is never covered. Pulse researches overnight and delivers a morning digest.
solves_zh: 助手只在你打开它时才开口，所以没想到问的就永远不会被提。Pulse 夜里自己去查，早上送来一份简报。
best_for: Nothing to open now — scheduled tasks took over its proactive updates.
best_for_zh: 现在已经没有产品可用了，主动推送并入了定时任务。
notes: 集成在 ChatGPT 内的能力。来源：https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-pulse/ 2026-11-25：status active → discontinued。OpenAI 官方更新日志（2026-06-17 一节）：「Pulse is being sunset as proactive updates move into scheduled tasks. Pro users will continue to have access for 14 days from today.」 2026-11-25：desc "A daily briefing it researches for you each night." → "A daily briefing ChatGPT researched overnight, sunset in June 2026."。产品已下线，摘要里不再用现在时 2026-11-25：desc_zh "夜里自己去查资料、清早推给你的一份每日简报。" → "ChatGPT 夜里查资料、清早推送的每日简报，2026 年 6 月已下线。"。产品已下线，摘要里写明 2026-11-25：best_for "You want a short daily digest, and accept that a preview will sometimes miss." → "Nothing to open now — scheduled tasks took over its proactive updates."。产品已下线 2026-11-25：best_for_zh "你想要一份每日短简报，也接受它作为预览版偶尔跑偏。" → "现在已经没有产品可用了，主动推送并入了定时任务。"。产品已下线
